articles.title: Ed Sheeran admits 'mistakes' as he addresses Macklemore controversy at Philadelphia show
articles.description: The mega-star spoke about the issue and about Israel and Gaza at his first concert since rapper Macklemore was removed from his tour and other artists dropped out.

articles.title: Houthis say they targeted Saudi capital with ballistic missiles
